en: You won't be able to pass.
It's a real shame, too.
We only just spent all that money carving out the stairway and building the bridges.
We might not be able to repair the bridges any time soon, but if we had the funds, we could get a quick fix on the stairway.
Would you be willing to donate anything?
If we can raise enough money, the stairway could be completed quickly.
\GIt would probably cost about $40,000 in total.
ATTENDANT: That's-- oh my word.
I'll set the crew to work right away!
Done in record time!
The road is now open! Thank you so much!
ATTENDANT: Er, that's very generous of you, but you don't even have that much.
Still, the thought is appreciated.
ATTENDANT: That's all right.
Someday.
\GThe remaining repairs total $ \v[333].
ATTENDANT: How much would you like to donate?
ATTENDANT: Then-- that's it! That's all we need!
ATTENDANT: Thank you very much! This will be a huge step towards our goal!
CHARLOTTE: 'Sup, \PN?
You're probably wondering what happened to Saphira here.
The truth is...
I finally set her on fire too.
CHARLOTTE: Hah! Just kidding.
Did you believe me?
CHARLOTTE: Ahaha! Good! That's fun.
But you should know I would never do anything to harm my sister.
And if anyone else tried, I'd burn them instead.
CHARLOTTE: Really? Geez.
I would never do anything to harm my sisters.
CHARLOTTE: Awh, boring.
CHARLOTTE: Yeah? Too bad.
But I guess you were right.
Maybe you understand after all.
I found her like this in the Control Center under Calcenon.
She said she was going there, but she was taking way too long, so I went to go get her.
With everyone disappearing or whatever, obviously that's not the smartest move.
It's like a horror movie or whatever, right?
Just don't split up.
Duh.
Like you are now, huh?
But if anything did happen to her, I wouldn't really care what happened to me.
There wouldn't be a point.
So I went for it.
Found her like this.
Hauled her here.
Was just taking a break in here-- turns out, carrying someone like her isn't the easiest thing.
She's in rough shape, but alive.
That's what matters.
And believe me, if I thought Team Meteor was responsible for this, Labradorra City would already be torched.
But judging by the damage down there, she probably did this to herself.
Went on a rampage.
Took it out on some defenseless machine.
Probably shocked herself in the process.
And take a look at her hand.
That's a lock of Laura's hair, impressively still clenched in her fist.
Looks like a clean cut to me.
Team Meteor probably took it from her and left it down there as bait.
It's just a guess, but I'm assuming Saphira saw it and went into a frenzy.
Wouldn't be the first time.
So they have Laura too, and they want us.
All of us, probably.
You're gonna do something about it?
CHARLOTTE: That's right, wrecking ball, take the bait so we don't have to.
Make that horror movie dream come true.
CHARLOTTE: That's the sensible thing.
But who ever got anywhere by being sensible?
As much as I also want to go look for Laura, I'm not leaving Saphira alone like this.
So whatever you're doing, good luck.
CHARLOTTE: Guess it took me a while to lug Saphira this far up here after all.
I'll get her back to safety soon enough.
In the meantime, raise some hell for me.
There's no response.
A long, clean lock of pink hair is wound inside her still-clenched fist.
Something unseeable is in the way.
\PN used the Silvon Scope.
The startled Pokémon attacked!
Many travelers come here to survey Tourmaline Desert before they venture out into it.
Are you the same way?
Then take a good look.
If you follow the rail north, you'll come up on the Scrapyard.
Numerous trains have been derailed there and no one has been able to clean them up.
Careful not to go too far north though! Those sandstorms can get mighty fierce, and it's not safe for people to travel in on foot.
Further south of that, there's supposed to be a cave buried under the sands somewhere.
In the north-east, I hear other Trainers can see an old tower, but I've never seen it personally.
And finally, those mountains in the north-west-- those are the Teknite Mountains!
I'm fixin' to hike those myself!
Hi. Don't mind me, I'm just people-watching.
They run around like everything they do is so important.
Then again, it's not like I'm any better.
Always watching, never doing.
Hmm. So they need help at the Coral Gym?
I guess it's my turn to do something after all.
COREY: The view of the desert is just wonderful, don't you think?
COREY: It's been a while, \PN.
Is Heather well? Are you well?
Ah, but this must be very confusing for you.
Come, enjoy the view with me; I'll explain what's going on.
COREY: I died.
But Shade ensured a small part of me still remained.
Not enough to be meaningful, of course, but...
Well, many things that meant nothing began to mean a lot with the creation of the New World.
And here I am.
I've been watching you explore the New World, you know.
Helping Pokémon, and even helping people.
I keep just missing you, though.
I've been trying to track you down, so after all this time...
After all this time, I can finally...
Apologize.
COREY: I said some hurtful things to you in my darkest hour.
Know that you aren't responsible for my actions and choices.
I needed to say that.
COREY: ...So, I hear you met my wife?
Elena, the Skyspectre.
She was my world; and the day I lost her, my world ended.
But... losing one's own life brings a sense of clarity.
Even if all I have are memories of her, I'm still the luckiest man to have ever lived.
She was just unstoppable.
Whether it was battling, or just her day to day life, she could do anything she wanted.
She's the reason I love this view.
She had a rather macabre sense of humor, you see.
We'd often come out here for dates.
At the mildest inconvenience, she'd jump off the bridge, only to fly back up on her Salamence moments later.
If there were any particularly concerned onlookers, she'd even send up a Ghost Type first just to freak them out.
I'm pretty sure that's the entire reason she chose Ghost as her second type.
She really was just... perfect.
COREY: I could talk forever about how wonderful she was.
About how much I miss her.
But I'll have plenty of time to reminisce later.
Elena was so... unfailingly hopeful for the future.
And I think I finally see it.
Reborn is healing.
The people of Reborn are healing.
And the region has the finest Champion it ever has.
I can't help but wonder, though...
She was always so certain that I would be the next Champion.
Perhaps I would have been!
I was quite talented, you know.
At least, I was before she...
Well, before I gave up trying.
But I've had time to try again while wandering the New World.
Not very long, of course but...
Elena always compared me to those child Champions of other regions.
The ones who get their first Pokémon and are Champion a week later.
With how quickly I picked up battling, she was convinced I could've been that for Reborn if I started a decade or two earlier.
But better late than never, right?
The future of Reborn is bright with you at the helm, \PN.
But she believed in me so much...
It would be a disservice to her to not believe in myself at least as much.
I think we are long overdue a fight.
A fair fight.
One where I'm not filled with despair. Or rage. Or murderous intent.
One where I try...
Where I remember the love for battle I had forgotten.
So bring it on, Champion \PN.
Let's see if you would've been able to take the title from me if I had've gotten it first!
COREY: Brilliant!
But don't get comfortable.
By the time I have all the badges to challenge you officially, I'll be at least twice as good!
COREY: Wait, no, I...
What's happening?
I don't want to go back to--
COREY: \PN.
When did you get here?
Did you come to kill me again?
Did you want a repeat show?
Take another swing at poisoning my daughter's mind against me?
Or perhaps you just wanted to show up and make a terrorist group get desperate and sloppy again?
COREY: Things were more dangerous for everyone because of you.
Everything you touch turns toxic.
Truly, a fitting Champion for this region.
COREY: Ace. Solaris. Me.
People died because Meteor got desperate.
Animals are most dangerous when they're cornered.
Make no mistake, their deaths-- and the countless others Meteor caused-- are your fault.
And you could traipse through the New World and find every single one of them, if you wanted.
But nothing would change.
Their blood will always be on your hands.
I am naught but poison to those around me.
But you are poison to everything.
And I will make sure you never have the satisfaction of saving everyone.
You'll never get to pat yourself on the back for that.
COREY: Because one will still always be gone.
And it will always be your fault.
COREY: Elena, my darling...
I came here every day...
Hoping I'd see you fly up on that Salamence once more...
But I know you can't come back to me.
But perhaps... I can come back to you...?
I wanted to go chasing the horizon with you one more time...
Fly a little faster, darling...
Just a little more, and I'd swear we could reach out and touch the moon.
Hello! Would you like to play Sweet Scent's special promotional puzzle for a shot at a sensational prize?
We have a winner!
And for your prize, we present your very own Sweet Scent-sponsored Spritzee!
Well, take your time! This promotion won't end anytime soon!
Oh? Any time!
Hello! Have you ever seen a spot of soil that looked rich and nutritious?
Because, well... I haven't.
I don't think there are any places like that left within the city.
But I want to think, that maybe someday, there will be.
So, here.
If you ever find one, please use this. Help the plants there grow into great big trees!
If you ever find a Berry tree, be sure to take good care of it!
Hello! Have you been to our garden?
We have all worked very hard on it as a community, and I'm very proud to say that it's now a wonderful area for everyone in the city to enjoy!
Please, if you're ever in the area, help out!
If you use this, you can help the plants there grow into great big trees!
And if you ever find a Berry tree, be sure to take good care of it!
Excuse me, have you seen a Budew wandering around anywhere?
Oh my, you did?
It fell into the Peridot Ward?!
How could we be so careless?!
Goodness, thank you so much for saving the little thing!
I've been worried sick ever since it disappeared.
It had developed a bad habit of running outside, but when it didn't come back...
Well, never mind! You should do me a favor.
No, think of it more as a 'thank you'.
Please keep Budew, okay?
Clearly it's too restless to stay in a place like this anymore.
You can probably serve it better than we can.
Hello! Have you seen the Lapis Community Garden?
Just on the east side of 5th Street, Sweet Scent is proud to sponsor the community's effort in rebuilding our great city.
If you'd like to get in on business with the fastest- growing company, please consider joining our wonderful team!
We offer applications online, or from our brand-new company HQ at 9th and Saffron.
By the way, how's that little Budew doing these days?
Hmm...
Oh, you've still got the little one!
Fantastic.
You know, since you seem to care for this Pokémon so much, have you ever thought about spending more time with it?
The next time someone asks you for a password, try telling them "budewit"!
I'm sure you'll just love what happens!
Care for some all Natural Gifts?
Quality Nectar sold here, imported straight from Alola!  This delicacy will spruce up any routine!
Quality import Nectar and assorted Seeds are sold here! Don't miss this chance!
Gosh, don't they have any Herbal Extract in stock...?
I was really hoping I could pick one up for my allergies.
Hey. You.
Yeah, you. You seem chill. Are you chill?
I knew it.
Nice try. A person who's not chill would never say that.
Look, my name's Salleigh, and I need your help with something.
We got this big commission recently...
From a uhhhhhhh, "Laura Belrose".
With a name like that, I swear she should be the one working in this place,
But she's not. I am.
And here's the tea-- have you noticed how all of the other employees have the exact same hair and dress?
It's creepy, isn't it?
It's like they just give up their humanity to become flower shop girls.
It's been skeeving me out ever since I got here.
They wanted me to dye my hair too, and wear the uniform.
I fell asleep on break ONE time and when I woke up, they'd already styled it this way.
So I said, "No! I can do this job just as good as any of you without conforming to your dress code!"
And now my boss has it out for me, and he assigned me this whole commission to handle all by myself, and if I don't finish it in time--
I-- I don't know how I'll be able to go on living.
I really need this job, but if I don't do this perfectly...
They're going to dye my hair green.
Can you believe it?! Green!
I've never met a single person who had green hair and WASN'T fucked up somehow.
The client asked for us to make a perfume from a handful of Pokémon.
Specifically, ones that have flowers somewhere on their body.
But I signed up here to handle flowers-- NOT Pokémon.
I'm useless with those.
MORE than useless.
One time I tried to catch a Caterpie.
I ended up String Shot and suspended upside down for a week.
You have to help me.
SALLEIGH: I'm counting on you. My livelihood is at stake here.
We just need Pokémon species that have a flower somewhere on their body.
Three in total! If you have any, please help!
Two more! Please rescue me!
Only one more! If you don't save me, I'm gonna be green for the rest of my days!
SALLEIGH: Please.
Please, I'm begging you.
Anything with a flower.
Help.
SALLEIGH: That's-- That's it! That's all we need!
We've done it!
I won't look like a cucumber!
Perfume mixing is easy-- check me out.
SALLEIGH: Hit 'em with a little bit of Bang!
Hit 'em with a little bit of Pow!
Mix it up like a Maractus, and...
SALLEIGH: Shika-shake-a-wowowow!
SALLEIGH: Presto-kapowleen!
Now my hair need not be green!
You really got me out of a pickle-colored pickle there!
Take this for your trouble!
SALLEIGH: And hey, if anyone asks you about your involvement here...
Tell them NOTHING.
No, better yet... If anyone asks you something strange, tell them "freerainbow".
That'll get them off my case for sure.
I'm going to go fill my boss's desk with chewed bubblegum now.
Cya!
SALLEIGH: This... This will work.
Is this what hope feels like...?
But we're not done yet!
How we doing today? Up for a round?
Ask me if I hate this.
I hate this.
The angry Tauros attacked!
Bouffalant roars triumphantly!
...Bouffalant charged blindly away!
...It sounds like Bouffalant crashed into something!
The angry Bouffalant attacked!
Tauros roars triumphantly!
Tauros seems thankful and compliant.
Do you want to try and ride the Tauros?
Ah, hello again. Have you come to donate a Dunsparce to us?
The Azurine Observation and Breeding Facility has been beyond tardy in their shipments of Pokémon for reintroduction.
We were scheduled to re-establish the Dunsparce population last month, but there's been no word from them.
It is a poor substitute, but, Trainer, should you encounter any Dunsparce, please consider donating them to us.
I will offer you a young Pokémon in return. We had planned to reintroduce them to the wild before, but were forced to cancel that operation.
I understand.
Wonderful! Let's begin at once.
\PN traded Dunsparce for Tyrogue!
This will be an excellent addition to the populations' re-establishment.
In fact, as a small extra thanks, why don't you take this as well?
Some of our old monitoring equipment was deprecated recently, and this was left over.
I hear some Trainers make use of it?
Please keep us in mind if you find any more Dunsparce!
The Miltank is calm and wears a collar.
Tauros is staring at the Miltank intensely.
Miltank-senpai doesn't seem to notice him.
Miltank returns the gaze, becoming lost in Tauros' eyes.
You feel that you could cut the sexual tension with a knife.
Miltank blushes and nuzzles against Tauros. It roars quietly as it breathes down the Miltank's neck.
You kind of want to dismount now.
Miltank bleats coyly and bows down to the Tauros.
You suspect you might be about to witness the live action version of 50 Shades of Bull.
Miltank notices the Oran Berry you hold.
Do you want to give Miltank the Berry?
\PN handed over the Oran Berry.
Miltank is moaning uncomfortably.
Miltank seems to be incredibly uncomfortable.
Miltank seems to be sleeping.
You decide it would be best to not leave the two alone, or else you may have no idea where an Egg came from.
Miltank and Tauros hold each other's gaze for a moment.
You suspect that this is the kind of Miltank that brings all the bulls to the yard in daylight.
Giddy-up!
Woah, there.
You's a fighter, huh.
HO!
Hoo-hah!
Guh... Too much.
Ah, someone else ventured outside the walls. Isn't it better out here?
Your spirit reminds me of someone else.
Even if it's more dangerous here, I'd rather take my chances than be caged up within the walls.
SANDY: Oh, hey \PN!
It's great to see you again!
I heard you fell out of existence for a while or something?
I mean, that happens sometimes, no sweat!
???: Oh, hello there!
Are you the one coming in from the Nightclub?
That's great! I could really use the help!
My name's Sandy! I'm an activist for the sake of Pokémon everywhere!
Anyway, could you help me out here?
This Miltank seems really sick, but for some reason no one in the center wants to do anything about it!
I think she just ate too many Oran Berries and needs to be milked...
Either that or she's pregnant.
But definitely one of the two!
Wait, if Pokémon lay eggs, can they still get pregnant?
Can you be pregnant with an egg???
Eggnant!?!!?
Well, nevermind!
If we can get Miltank's internal temperature we can probably figure out what's wrong!
I already, uh, "borrowed" a thermometer from inside,
And I'm pretty sure I read that the most accurate way to get a reading is through the, uhm, rectum.
The problem is, I've been having trouble getting her to let me check!
So, here's the plan.
I'll hold her steady, and you insert the thermometer and get a read, okay?
No?
...Oh, right! We were supposed to be checking out the Anomalies reported here!
Mmmmmm...
I just can't leave this poor creature to suffer like this, though!
I'm going to help it no matter what!
Can I trust you to look for the Anomalies?
From what I've gathered, there should be one in the North Aventurine Woods, one in the South Aventurine Woods, and another somewhere else near here.
I'll be here for moral support too!
Just let me know if you need a reminder!
SANDY: Baby, come on, this is for your own good!
Just let me put it in!!!
Oh, did you want me to remind you where the thingies were?
Wish me luck too... I clearly need it.
SANDY: Ugh, come on, just let me get it--
Oh, \PN...
Are you having any luck?
I'm sure not...
I finally got to check its temperature, but then the thermometer got stuck in there!
And now she won't let me get it out!!!
Anyway, do you need a reminder?
Say, do you want to switch jobs?
Boo...
The Tauros is absolutely wild!
...Do you want to try and ride it?
...The Tauros charged off!
Got bucked off!
SANDY: Hi, \PN...
...Good news!
The thermometer finally came out of its butt!...
...Also, so did what was apparently the Nature Center staff's entire supply of cream puffs...
They let me clean myself up afterwards, but I know why no one wanted to deal with this now...
\PN, it...
It was awful...
It was everywhere...
I need some time...
SANDY: Did...
Did you find them all?
That's... good.
I'll... just head back now...
Thanks for your help,
And, yeah, by 'help,' I mean doing the entire thing for me during my extremely traumatic experience...
I think when I go back to the Nightclub, I'm giving up field work.
A desk job sounds great, doesn't it?
Inside.
With the air purifiers.
And no Miltank ever.
That sounds... just lovely...
So everyone else didn't do anything, huh? Guess it's up to me.
Right then.
Fern's gonna kick the crap out of me...
So much for the gate, huh? Your road ends here.
Oh, you mean that gate key.
Look, tell Fern I gave you hell, okay?
Tehehehe, do you think you're ready to best us?
Your display of your battling prowess far exceeds ours...
Bravo~
Step into the arena, test your skills!
You pass!
These practice arenas are great, but sometimes get a little messy.

"All about Starmie, the Mysterious Pokémon."
"Starmie, the evolved form of Staryu, boasts greatly improved stats and viability from its pre-evolution.
Regrettably, the natural movepool is not one of Starmie's strengths. Like most stone-evolved Pokémon, its natural moves become severely limited.

Ugh, I can't get any of these questions...
I guess I have to read up.
I think the answers are in the books around the school-- even just the ones lying on the floor.
What a mess.
Hey, haven't I seen you around here before?
You must be...
That's right, you're a new student, aren't you?
Hey, you're kinda cute. If you wanna hang out, call me.
Moves that never miss? That's like, Swift and Aerial Ace, right?
Umm, you're that p-person all the other students have been talking about, aren't you?
C-could I m-maybe, uhm...
Could I get your autograph?
Aah! I'll treasure this forever!
...After I show it off, of course.

Just read the books around the school, and I bet you'll find your answers!

You are quite a common distraction for my students.  Some of them follow you like tabloids.

Can't stand the lot of them myself, and I donno why anyone puts up with him.
???: Just the bystander then?
Apologies for the rough ride.
A lout named Fern's got all his groupies goin' on about someone or other.
Man's got all the charm of a dusty Stunfisk and about as much honor.
So you're locked out, huh?
This switch's what does the deed, but it's a little janked out at times.
Scoot.

HARDY: Name's Hardy, by the way.
Gym Leader by profession, rock star by aspiration...
...Student by technicality.
I've got chords to catch, so I'mma split.
You keep on keepin' on, mate.
Give Fern hell for me.

Whereas in other regions, Pokémon afflicted with Forest's Curse or Trick or Treat act as if they have a third type, apparently that's not the case here.

I wonder why?

Just come right on in, why don't you?
???: No, sorry... I suppose I should be used to this.
Just, have the entire living room be a Gym-- why not.
Those contractors did a rush job in the first place and didn't even bother coming out for seconds!
Not like we needed the work or anything...
Bet they took one look at the place and begged for mercy from the Lord almighty on the spot.
???: Sorry, you here for a League challenge?
The Gym Leader, Aya, is my daughter.
My name is Lana, and my husband is Tez.
Nice to meet you, I guess.
AYA: OKAY, I'M A LITTLE BUSY RIGHT NOW.
LANA: Well, it's been a busy day.
She's currently in battle with a different Trainer.
I suppose you're free to go and watch, if you'd like.
LANA: By the way, the machine behind me can be used to recover your Pokémon, if you need.
I guess that's just a thing we're supposed to live with people doing in the living room.
You know, they could stand to pay her more.
I keep telling her she should march on down to the Grand Hall and talk to someone about it, but...
Kids these days are a little...
Well, you know.
LANA: I'm so proud of Aya.
You know with this as her job, she's supporting us all by herself.
She really is a wonderful daughter.
LANA: That green-haired boy is so rude.
